ai_summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited (AHCL) has successfully established Orbit Healthcare Services Nigeria Ltd. as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, completing its previously announced expansion into the Nigerian market via its Mauritius-based entity. This strategic move signifies AHCL's increasing geographical footprint and potential for growth in Africa by consolidating its international operations. The update is a standard regulatory filing detailing the completion of a corporate action, without any immediate red flags presented within this communication.
